channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: US Marine Corps orders more BAE-built Amphibious Vehicles
item.description: The ACV-30 is equipped with a 30mm cannon and is intended to provide increased firepower for engaging targets at range. The post US Marine Corps orders more BAE-built Amphibious Vehicles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No, Rosyth is not going to host nuclear weapons
item.description: Claims echoed by local media that Rosyth Dockyard could be set to "host nuclear weapons" are, frankly, nonsense. The post No, Rosyth is not going to host nuclear weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First 100 Ajax vehicles withdrawn and awaiting ‘upgrades’
item.description: The first 100 Ajax armoured fighting vehicles for the British Army are currently not in service with any unit as they await planned upgrades. The post First 100 Ajax vehicles withdrawn and awaiting ‘upgrades’ first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE launches incubator to spin defence tech into businesses
item.description: BAE Systems has launched a new technology incubator programme aimed at taking defence-developed technologies into wider commercial markets. The post BAE launches incubator to spin defence tech into businesses first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RFA Argus fate still unresolved as ministers cite secrecy
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has declined to provide an updated assessment on the future of RFA Argus and RFA Fort Victoria. The post RFA Argus fate still unresolved as ministers cite secrecy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain sends stealth F-35s to Cyprus as Iran tensions rise
item.description: Britain has deployed a number of F-35B fighter jets to RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus as tensions in the Middle East continue to rise. The post Britain sends stealth F-35s to Cyprus as Iran tensions rise first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Army moves to widen career paths for late entry officers
item.description: Late entry officers in the British Army face no formal restrictions on which officer appointments they can hold, with all officers now considered under a single merit-based selection system. The post Army moves to widen career paths for late entry officers first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK Government rules out Meta role in defence AI development
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said it does not use services from Meta to build artificial intelligence systems for UK national security purposes. The post UK Government rules out Meta role in defence AI development first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MoD insists Gurkha pensions already match British troops
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said Gurkha pension arrangements are already aligned for most service. The post MoD insists Gurkha pensions already match British troops first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rules out US-style procurement scheme for defence
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said it has no plans to recruit a dedicated cadre of former defence industry executives. The post UK rules out US-style procurement scheme for defence first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
